narrative.overview: A knowledgeable colleague at the next desk, walking a technician through a printed maintenance task card: one step at a time, the evidence on the table, nothing hidden. Warmth comes from roles, not decoration: terracotta means your move, marigold means waiting for you, sage means cleared. The manual's own words are always set in a second, hyperlegible face.
keyCharacteristics: Light theme only, warm stone neutrals
Four status hues, one meaning each, always with a word or icon
Two voices in type: system sans for the app, Atkinson Hyperlegible for the manual
A sentence before a score; a human title before an identifier
Fixed-height Verify frame on wide screens

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each hue has one job; blue is focus only.

rules.name: The Red Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Brick appears only when a check or a write failed.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every coloured state also carries a word or an icon.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Manual words in Atkinson Hyperlegible, app words in the system sans.

rules.name: The Flat Until Touched Rule
rules.body: If two neighbouring surfaces both have shadows, one of them is wrong.

dos: Do put a human title before every identifier and keep the id beside it in 12px mono.
Do say what will happen before it happens.
Do show both OCR readings as labelled lines in the manual face.
Do keep every count a server count, with the reconciliation line under any total.
donts: Don't build consumer onboarding carousels and confetti.
Don't show a single confidence number with no reason.
Don't drift toward dark hacker dashboards or marketing gradients.
Don't colour a passed check red.
Don't use exclamation marks, em dashes, hype or a time-left estimate.
Don't use side-stripe borders, glass, or nested cards.
